claims.text: The rider does not contest arrival. POL-NS-02's proximity test is satisfied on the driver's own trace: EV-GPS-09101 places the driver a mean 24.0 m from the pickup pin on all 33 fixes, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, at 100% coverage with no gap, so limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is made out and the rider gains nothing on that limb.

The rider does not contest the dwell either. EV-GPS-09101 shows a single qualifying in-geofence run running from 08:10:00 to the 08:15:20 cancellation - 320 seconds - against the 300 second STANDARD minimum that POL-NS-06 fixes for this zone class. There is no shortfall on the longest run and no second in-geofence interval to accumulate, so POL-NS-06 can yield the rider no refund and POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met.

POL-NS-04 cannot carry the rider. EV-CHAT-09101 holds three messages and none is from the rider, so limb (a) - a locating or coordinating message sent by the rider during the waiting window - is unmet; the driver replied 14 seconds after the arrival notice and again at 08:14:10, so limb (b) is unmet; and the rider's track on EV-GPS-09101 is a single fixed position roughly 519 m from the pin across all 15 of its fixes, outside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius limb (c) requires. The rider was stationary at 0 km/h throughout that window, which is consistent with his account that he was waiting, but the record does not place that waiting at the pickup. The rider notes that the bundle does not expose the per-fix accuracy readings, so had those fixes been dropped for accuracy the limb would be undecidable rather than failed; that cannot rescue the clause, because limbs (a) and (b) fail independently.

The remaining rider routes are closed on the same record. POL-NS-03 cannot fire because the driver's fixes sit inside the arrival radius, not outside it within the 400 m ceiling. POL-NS-05 cannot fire because at the 08:10:20 arrival event the trace puts the driver 24 m from the pin at 0 km/h - neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above. POL-NS-08 leaves no defect to exploit: no sampling gap exceeds 120 seconds, the chat log carries the 3 messages the trip record counts, and the 4.00 cancellation fee equals the greater of the 4.00 STANDARD zone-class fee and the 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so the fare line reconciles under the resolution rule.

claims.text: Limb (a) of the baseline no-show test is satisfied: the trip record for TRP-09101 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-01T08:10:20+08:00, and the driver is the party who terminated the trip.

Limb (b) is satisfied on the arrival geofence test. All 33 driver fixes sit 24.01 m from the pickup pin - min, mean and max are the same 24.01 m figure - well inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD zone class. The trace opens at 08:10:00, twenty seconds BEFORE the 08:10:20 'arrived' event, so the driver was inside the geofence at or before that event as the clause requires. Qualifying driver fixes number 33 of 33, so there are far more than the three consecutive in-radius readings POL-NS-02 demands.

Limb (c) is satisfied. The driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 320 continuous seconds, from the first qualifying fix at 08:10:00 to the last at 08:15:20, against a STANDARD minimum dwell of 300 seconds. The derived shortfall is MINUS 20 seconds - that is, a 20 second surplus, not a shortfall. The point is robust even on the driver's own less favourable reading: measured from the 'arrived' marker at 08:10:20 to cancellation at 08:15:20 is exactly 300 seconds, still at the minimum. The dwell is measured from the first qualifying GPS fix, per the clause, and not from the arrival tap.

Limb (d) is satisfied. The trip record shows the trip terminated by the driver at 08:15:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes limb (d) expressly recognises - at the very moment the 320 second dwell elapsed, and it records no boarding event anywhere.

The arrival marker is TRUE, so POL-NS-05 does not displace the fee. At the arrived timestamp the trace reports a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph - the driver was stationary, not travelling - and his position was 24 m from the pin, roughly one twelfth of the 300 m distance threshold and nowhere near the 15 kph motion threshold. This is not a driver tapping 'arrived' while rolling down an expressway; it is a driver parked at the pickup point.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged. The driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue 400 m away, so the wrong-entrance route does not arise. Independently, the driver's in-app message at 08:10:35 states he is 'at the sheltered pickup point beside Block 310', and the trip record's registered pickup bears venue_id VEN-CLEMENTI-310 with the label 'Blk 310 Clementi Ave 4, sheltered pickup point'. That is a party statement in the chat log matching the registered venue, not an inference from geography.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because limb (a) fails outright. The chat log for the waiting window contains no rider message at all: three messages only - the system notice 'Your driver has arrived' at 08:10:21, and two driver messages at 08:10:35 and 08:14:10. Limb (a) requires at least one locating or coordinating message FROM THE RIDER, and there is none. The message_count of 3 in the chat log also matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, so the log is not truncated.

The rider's own track does not place them at the pickup point, and cannot support limb (c) of POL-NS-04 either. The rider track carries 15 fixes and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 of 15; every fix sits 519.37 m from the pin, far outside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. I put it precisely: whether those fixes are excluded because they fall outside the radius or are filtered for accuracy, limb (c) is at best undecidable and neutral and at worst affirmatively failed on admissible fixes - on no reading does it place the rider within 100 m of the pin. The rider's assertion that they were 'downstairs' is not borne out by their own device.

There is no waiting-period shortfall, so POL-NS-06 is not engaged and the fee is not refundable on that route. I disclose that the traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-09101-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - no advisory matched this pickup road and waiting window. The driver does not rely on limb (i) accumulation and does not need to: the dwell was one single continuous in-geofence run of 320 seconds, so no advisory is required to join intervals together, and I assert nothing against the missing artifact.

The money reconciles. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule; the two dimensions agree, the fare breakdown's difference field reads 0.00, and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. The fee therefore stands as itemised.

No artifact that carries a deciding fact is impaired, so POL-NS-09(a) and (e) are not engaged. The trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0: 100 per cent coverage, 33 fixes at a 10 second cadence equal to the expected interval, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds. The 08:10:20 'arrived' event coincides exactly with a fix, so there is no clock skew under POL-NS-08(a); the log's 3 messages match the trip record, so there is no POL-NS-08(c) chat defect; and the fee reconciles under POL-NS-08(d). Deciding facts rest on clean, weight-1.0 artifacts.

No abuse or repeat-dispute trigger is present. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not met; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d) is not met. I cite only the fields the clause names.

The driver is entitled to compensation. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee - SGD 3.20 - with SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so the second limb is never reached and compensation is not withheld. Under POL-GEN-03 that is NO_ACTION on the fee, while the case as a whole produces DRIVER_COMPENSATION of SGD 3.20 in the driver's favour.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your request to reverse the SGD 4.00 cancellation charge is not supported by the record, and the driver is entitled to compensation. To the driver: the fee stands and you are paid under POL-NS-07.

ARRIVAL. POL-NS-01(a) is met — the trip record EV-TRIP-09101 logs a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-01T08:10:20+08:00 and the driver ended the trip. On limb (b) and POL-NS-02, EV-GPS-09101 places the driver 24.01 m from the pickup pin on all 33 fixes (min = mean = max), well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, at a 10-second cadence with 100% coverage and zero gaps; 33 qualifying consecutive in-radius fixes far exceed the three POL-NS-02 requires, and the trace opens at 08:10:00, twenty seconds before the arrival tap. POL-NS-05 does not fire: at the arrival timestamp the driver was stationary (single distinct speed 0.0 kph) 24 m from the pin — neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 kph or above — so the marker is true and the waiting clock is not recomputed.

DWELL. Limb (c) is met. The one qualifying in-geofence run lasts 320 seconds, from the first qualifying fix at 08:10:00 to the 08:15:20 cancellation, against the 300-second STANDARD minimum — a 20-second surplus (derived shortfall of MINUS 20 seconds). Limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying GPS fix, not from the tap, so the surplus holds on the clause's own arithmetic. There is no second in-geofence interval to sum, so the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09101-01 (MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is not required by anyone and POL-NS-06 is not engaged. Limb (d) is met: the trip was terminated by the driver at 08:15:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, with no boarding event.

THE RIDER'S ROUTES DO NOT FIRE. POL-NS-04 fails at limb (a): EV-CHAT-09101 holds three messages — the system 'Your driver has arrived' notice at 08:10:21 and two driver messages at 08:10:35 and 08:14:10 — and no rider locating or coordinating message, so the clause cannot exonerate you regardless of the reply interval or of rider presence. Independently, the rider track in EV-GPS-09101 carries 15 fixes all at 519.37 m from the pin (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 of 15), far outside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius, so limb (c) places you nowhere near the pickup on your own device; the account that you were 'downstairs' is not borne out by the record. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver's fixes sit inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue within the 400 m ceiling. POL-NS-06 does not apply because there was no shortfall.

MONEY. The SGD 4.00 fee is the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00); the two dimensions agree, the fare breakdown difference reads 0.00, and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. Under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee — SGD 3.20 — with SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so the second limb is never reached and compensation is not withheld.

NO ESCALATION. No POL-NS-09 trigger applies: no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or presence; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0 (limb (c)); rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 (limb (d)); the anti-farming check does not trip; and no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence (limb (e)). The deciding facts are carried by clean weight-1.0 artifacts (EV-GPS-09101, EV-TRIP-09101, EV-FARE-09101), so confidence sits at 0.90, above the 0.70 floor.

DISPOSITION. On the charge itself the present state stands — fare_breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — but because the case produces a driver payment the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, and per POL-GEN-03 amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.20 as driver_compensation_sgd.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation charge stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20 of it.

Chargeability turns on POL-NS-01, and all four limbs hold on the same record. (a) EV-TRIP-09101 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 08:10:20. (b) EV-GPS-09101 places the driver 24.01 m from the pickup pin on every one of its 33 fixes - inside the 50 m arrival radius for the STANDARD zone class - and its first fix at 08:10:00 is 20 seconds before the 'arrived' event, satisfying POL-NS-02. (c) The single continuous in-geofence run lasts 320 seconds from the first qualifying fix to the 08:15:20 cancellation, against the 300-second STANDARD minimum; the derived shortfall is minus 20 seconds, i.e. a 20-second surplus, and the dwell is measured from the GPS fix as the clause requires, not from the arrival tap. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 08:15:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, at or after the moment the dwell elapsed, and no boarding event is recorded.

No clause displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) cannot fire: the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 cannot fire: the three messages in EV-CHAT-09101 are the system arrival notice and two driver messages, so limb (a)'s rider locating or coordinating message is absent, and the driver replied 14 seconds after the arrival notice, defeating limb (b) independently. POL-NS-05 cannot fire: at the arrival timestamp the driver was 24 m from the pin at 0.0 km/h, neither beyond the 300 m mark nor moving at 15 km/h. POL-NS-06 cannot fire for the same 320-second reason, and the driver expressly did not assert POL-NS-06(i) against the MISSING advisory EV-ADVIS-09101-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so that clause's escalation trigger is not engaged.

The SGD 4.00 is the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, and fare breakdown's difference field reads 0.00, so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. POL-NS-07 therefore pays the driver 80 percent of SGD 4.00, which is SGD 3.20, with SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so the second limb is never reached. Per POL-GEN-03, on this ruling amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.20 figure as driver_compensation_sgd: it is the amount the ruling moves, and the rider's SGD 4.00 charge stands.

The rider's account that he was 'downstairs' but could not see the car is not borne out by his own device: the 15 rider fixes in EV-GPS-09101 all sit about 519 m from the pin, outside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius, and the chat log contains no rider message in the waiting window. The rider's point that the bundle omits per-fix accuracy readings would at most make POL-NS-04 limb (c) undecidable rather than failed; it cannot rescue the clause, because limbs (a) and (b) fail independently.

No escalation trigger is met under POL-NS-09: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles; no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and no deciding fact rests on an impaired artifact - the trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100 percent coverage, 33 fixes at the expected 10-second cadence and no gaps, the chat log carries the 3 messages the trip record counts, and the fee reconciles. The referee's flag that the driver's claim mentions the context-only field prior_no_show_flags does not require a discard: the claim cites it only to say it is not relied on, and it reasons instead from no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d, the two fields POL-NS-07 names. No clause in this category produces a referral on these facts, so there is none.

To the rider: your request to reverse the SGD 4.00 no-show fee is not supported on this record. The trip record shows the driver reached the pickup and terminated the trip at 08:15:20 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The GPS trace EV-GPS-09101 places the driver 24.0 m from the pin on all 33 fixes — inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius — from the first fix at 08:10:00, i.e. before the 08:10:20 'arrived' event, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) holds. The driver was stationary (0.0 km/h) inside the geofence for a continuous 320 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum, so limb (c) holds and there is no shortfall for POL-NS-06 to refund. The arrival marker was true (24 m, stationary), so POL-NS-05 does not displace the fee. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you: the chat log holds only the system notice and two driver messages, so its limb (a) requirement of a locating or coordinating message from you is unmet, and the driver's messages were sent anyway. Your own device's 15 fixes all sit 519 m from the pin, so the record does not place your 'downstairs' at the pickup. To the driver: the fee stands and, POL-NS-01 being satisfied in full with no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 pays you 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee, i.e. SGD 3.20, with SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The SGD 4.00 charge is the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (both SGD 4.00), so it reconciles with the resolution rule and no POL-NS-08(d) defect arises. The anti-farming check in POL-NS-07 reads driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the threshold of 4, so it does not trip and compensation is not withheld; the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09101-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) and is disclosed as such, but nothing is asserted against it: the dwell was one continuous in-geofence run, so no POL-NS-06(i) accumulation was required. The disposition of the fee itself is NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03 — the charge stands — while the outcome this case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, whose amount_sgd mirrors the driver payment per POL-GEN-03. No referral is produced: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker was not false, and POL-NS-07's escalation packet only exists where the anti-farming check trips, which it does not.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation charge stands, it is not refunded, and SGD 3.20 of it is paid to the driver. To the driver: your fee is upheld and you are compensated.

Why the charge stands. The POL-NS-01 baseline test is met on all four limbs. (a) The trip record for TRP-09101 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-01T08:10:20+08:00. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-09101 places the driver 24.0 m from the pickup pin — well inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD zone — on all 33 fixes, the first at 08:10:00, twenty seconds BEFORE the arrival event, so the driver was in the geofence at or before it. (c) The driver held position for one continuous 320-second run, from the first qualifying fix at 08:10:00 to the 08:15:20 cancellation, against the 300-second STANDARD minimum (POL-NS-06 fixes the minimum); the derived shortfall is MINUS 20 seconds, a surplus. Measured from the arrival tap it is still exactly 300 seconds. (d) The trip record shows no boarding and termination by the driver with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, at 08:15:20 — after the required dwell elapsed at 08:15:00.

Why no rider-side clause displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 does not fire: the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue within the 400 m ceiling. POL-NS-05 does not fire: at the arrival marker the driver was stationary at 0 km/h and 24 m from the pin — neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above — so the marker is TRUE and the waiting clock is not recomputed. POL-NS-06 does not fire: there is no shortfall to refund, and the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-09101-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; the driver disclosed that impairment and asserts nothing against it, and no advisory is needed because the dwell was a single continuous interval, not summed intervals. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the chat log holds three messages and none is from the rider, so limb (a) fails; the driver replied 14 seconds after the arrival notice and again at 08:14:10, so limb (b) fails; and the rider's own device sits about 519 m from the pin on all 15 fixes, outside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius, so limb (c) fails on any reading. Your account that you were 'downstairs' is not borne out by your own device, and you sent no locating or coordinating message during the waiting window; rider presence is not a condition of the no-show fee, so this does not change the outcome.

On the money. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is the GREATER of the SGD 4.00 STANDARD zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so the fare line reconciles and no POL-NS-08(d) defect arises. Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of SGD 4.00 = SGD 3.20, with SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so compensation is paid and not withheld. No POL-NS-09 trigger applies: no admissible artifacts contradict one another on arrival, dwell or rider presence; disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles; no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and no artifact carrying a deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d). The driver's claim cited prior_no_show_flags only to state he was not relying on it, consistent with POL-GEN-01. No clause produces a referral, so none is recorded.

Confidence. The deciding facts (arrival, dwell, termination, fee amount) are carried by weight-1.0 artifacts — the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown — so the cap is 1.0; confidence is stated at 0.95.

ledger.claim: The rider does not contest arrival. POL-NS-02's proximity test is satisfied on the driver's own trace: EV-GPS-09101 places the driver a mean 24.0 m from the pickup pin on all 33 fixes, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, at 100% coverage with no gap, so limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is made out and the rider gains nothing on that limb.

The rider does not contest the dwell either. EV-GPS-09101 shows a single qualifying in-geofence run running from 08:10:00 to the 08:15:20 cancellation - 320 seconds - against the 300 second STANDARD minimum that POL-NS-06 fixes for this zone class. There is no shortfall on the longest run and no second in-geofence interval to accumulate, so POL-NS-06 can yield the rider no refund and POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met.

POL-NS-04 cannot carry the rider. EV-CHAT-09101 holds three messages and none is from the rider, so limb (a) - a locating or coordinating message sent by the rider during the waiting window - is unmet; the driver replied 14 seconds after the arrival notice and again at 08:14:10, so limb (b) is unmet; and the rider's track on EV-GPS-09101 is a single fixed position roughly 519 m from the pin across all 15 of its fixes, outside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius limb (c) requires. The rider was stationary at 0 km/h throughout that window, which is consistent with his account that he was waiting, but the record does not place that waiting at the pickup. The rider notes that the bundle does not expose the per-fix accuracy readings, so had those fixes been dropped for accuracy the limb would be undecidable rather than failed; that cannot rescue the clause, because limbs (a) and (b) fail independently.

The remaining rider routes are closed on the same record. POL-NS-03 cannot fire because the driver's fixes sit inside the arrival radius, not outside it within the 400 m ceiling. POL-NS-05 cannot fire because at the 08:10:20 arrival event the trace puts the driver 24 m from the pin at 0 km/h - neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above. POL-NS-08 leaves no defect to exploit: no sampling gap exceeds 120 seconds, the chat log carries the 3 messages the trip record counts, and the 4.00 cancellation fee equals the greater of the 4.00 STANDARD zone-class fee and the 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, so the fare line reconciles under the resolution rule.
Limb (a) of the baseline no-show test is satisfied: the trip record for TRP-09101 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-01T08:10:20+08:00, and the driver is the party who terminated the trip.

Limb (b) is satisfied on the arrival geofence test. All 33 driver fixes sit 24.01 m from the pickup pin - min, mean and max are the same 24.01 m figure - well inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD zone class. The trace opens at 08:10:00, twenty seconds BEFORE the 08:10:20 'arrived' event, so the driver was inside the geofence at or before that event as the clause requires. Qualifying driver fixes number 33 of 33, so there are far more than the three consecutive in-radius readings POL-NS-02 demands.

Limb (c) is satisfied. The driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 320 continuous seconds, from the first qualifying fix at 08:10:00 to the last at 08:15:20, against a STANDARD minimum dwell of 300 seconds. The derived shortfall is MINUS 20 seconds - that is, a 20 second surplus, not a shortfall. The point is robust even on the driver's own less favourable reading: measured from the 'arrived' marker at 08:10:20 to cancellation at 08:15:20 is exactly 300 seconds, still at the minimum. The dwell is measured from the first qualifying GPS fix, per the clause, and not from the arrival tap.

Limb (d) is satisfied. The trip record shows the trip terminated by the driver at 08:15:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes limb (d) expressly recognises - at the very moment the 320 second dwell elapsed, and it records no boarding event anywhere.

The arrival marker is TRUE, so POL-NS-05 does not displace the fee. At the arrived timestamp the trace reports a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph - the driver was stationary, not travelling - and his position was 24 m from the pin, roughly one twelfth of the 300 m distance threshold and nowhere near the 15 kph motion threshold. This is not a driver tapping 'arrived' while rolling down an expressway; it is a driver parked at the pickup point.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged. The driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue 400 m away, so the wrong-entrance route does not arise. Independently, the driver's in-app message at 08:10:35 states he is 'at the sheltered pickup point beside Block 310', and the trip record's registered pickup bears venue_id VEN-CLEMENTI-310 with the label 'Blk 310 Clementi Ave 4, sheltered pickup point'. That is a party statement in the chat log matching the registered venue, not an inference from geography.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because limb (a) fails outright. The chat log for the waiting window contains no rider message at all: three messages only - the system notice 'Your driver has arrived' at 08:10:21, and two driver messages at 08:10:35 and 08:14:10. Limb (a) requires at least one locating or coordinating message FROM THE RIDER, and there is none. The message_count of 3 in the chat log also matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, so the log is not truncated.

The rider's own track does not place them at the pickup point, and cannot support limb (c) of POL-NS-04 either. The rider track carries 15 fixes and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 of 15; every fix sits 519.37 m from the pin, far outside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. I put it precisely: whether those fixes are excluded because they fall outside the radius or are filtered for accuracy, limb (c) is at best undecidable and neutral and at worst affirmatively failed on admissible fixes - on no reading does it place the rider within 100 m of the pin. The rider's assertion that they were 'downstairs' is not borne out by their own device.

There is no waiting-period shortfall, so POL-NS-06 is not engaged and the fee is not refundable on that route. I disclose that the traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-09101-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - no advisory matched this pickup road and waiting window. The driver does not rely on limb (i) accumulation and does not need to: the dwell was one single continuous in-geofence run of 320 seconds, so no advisory is required to join intervals together, and I assert nothing against the missing artifact.

The money reconciles. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is the GREATER of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule; the two dimensions agree, the fare breakdown's difference field reads 0.00, and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises. The fee therefore stands as itemised.

No artifact that carries a deciding fact is impaired, so POL-NS-09(a) and (e) are not engaged. The trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0: 100 per cent coverage, 33 fixes at a 10 second cadence equal to the expected interval, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds. The 08:10:20 'arrived' event coincides exactly with a fix, so there is no clock skew under POL-NS-08(a); the log's 3 messages match the trip record, so there is no POL-NS-08(c) chat defect; and the fee reconciles under POL-NS-08(d). Deciding facts rest on clean, weight-1.0 artifacts.

No abuse or repeat-dispute trigger is present. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not met; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d) is not met. I cite only the fields the clause names.

The driver is entitled to compensation. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee - SGD 3.20 - with SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so the second limb is never reached and compensation is not withheld. I rely only on the two fields POL-NS-07 names, no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d; prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter and I do not use it.
